Kaavakuva sähköverkon reitistä voimalait: Schematic of the route of electricity from the power plant to the home. From left to right: power plant and its transformer, national grid power line (voltage from 110 kV to 400 kV), substation, distribution network poles (20 kV) and home (0.4 kV, 230 V at the socket). Below, an orange arrow shows the flow of energy from the power plant to the home. Not to scale.
Kaavakuva kaukolämmön kierrosta. Vasemma: Schematic of the district heating loop. On the left the heating plant, on the right a home. A red supply pipe takes hot water to the home and a blue return pipe brings the cooled water back. The pipes are inside shared insulation underground. Orange arrows show that a little heat still escapes through the insulation into the ground. Not to scale.
Kaavakuva kolmesta energiavarastosta. Va: Schematic of three energy stores. On the left a battery, where the energy is chemical. In the middle a pumped-storage plant: upper reservoir, lower reservoir and a pipe in which water flows down. On the right a heat store, an insulated tank full of hot water. Not to scale.
Energiavirtakuva mittakaavassa. Ylhäällä: Energy flow diagram to scale. At the top the electricity grid: of the sent energy 96 % arrives and 4 % is lost. At the bottom the district heating network: 91 % arrives and 9 % is lost. The width of a stream is proportional to the energy; the width of the sent energy is the same in both.
